boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Baylor University
boards.description: Late-night dining at Baylor University is defined by a mix of on-campus traditions like Penland's late-night waffles and off-campus staples along the I-35 corridor and Speight Avenue.

cards.title: Late-Night Waffles at Penland
cards.subtitle: The primary on-campus late-night dining hall
cards.notes: Visit Monday through Thursday from 8 p.m. to midnight to enjoy the signature self-serve waffle stations and social atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Penland Crossroads is the central hub for on-campus late-night dining, famous among students for its evening waffle service.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night is available from 8 p.m. to midnight Monday through Thursday at the Penland Crossroads.
cards.source_title: Expand Late Night, or bust - The Baylor Lariat
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday-Thursday for late-night service.

cards.title: Study Fuel at Moody Starbucks
cards.subtitle: Caffeine for late-night research sessions
cards.notes: Order ahead via Grubhub to skip the line during peak study hours in the Moody Memorial Library foyer.
cards.short_summary: Located in the heart of the library, this Starbucks serves as the primary caffeine source for students during late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Starbucks Coffee location in Moody Memorial Library extended its hours of operation on Mondays through Fridays until midnight.
cards.source_title: Moody Starbucks Extends Hours Beginning March 24 - Baylor Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on weekdays to support student research.

cards.title: Coffee and Community at Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: A bohemian staple adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Check the clipboard inside for open mic sign-ups or enjoy a 'Cowboy Coffee' on the backyard-turned-stage.
cards.short_summary: Common Grounds is a long-standing coffee house next to Baylor known for its unique atmosphere and live music events.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds hosts an open mic every Wednesday night from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Open mic nights around Waco offer a stage unlike any other - The Baylor Lariat
cards.access_notes: Hosts evening events like open mic nights until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Pillows at Shorty's
cards.subtitle: New York-style slices near the 12th Street corridor
cards.notes: Order a signature Pizza Pillow or a slice by the pie on the large covered patio near the Baylor campus.
cards.short_summary: Shorty's is a popular student haunt specializing in New York-style pizza and 'Pizza Pillows' with a laid-back outdoor patio.
cards.evidence_claim: Shorty's Baylor location at 1712 S. 12th St. is open from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Shorty's Pizza Shack: Home
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11 p.m. at the 12th Street location.

cards.title: Warm Cookie Delivery on Speight
cards.subtitle: Late-night sweets delivered to dorms
cards.notes: Visit the Speight Avenue storefront for warm cookies or ice cream sandwiches well past midnight.
cards.short_summary: Insomnia Cookies provides late-night bakery treats and delivery services specifically catering to the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 1508 Speight Ave offers warm cookie delivery and baked treats until late night.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies | Warm Cookie Delivery & Baked Treats Until Late Night
cards.access_notes: Specializes in late-night service and delivery to the Baylor area.

cards.title: 24-Hour Honey Butter Chicken Biscuits
cards.subtitle: The quintessential Texas 24-hour run
cards.notes: Head to the 7th Street location for a late-night burger or breakfast starting at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Texas institution, this 24-hour Whataburger is a frequent destination for students after late-night events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Whataburger at 928 S 7th St in Waco is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 928 S 7TH ST WACO, TX
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Cane's Sauce and Chicken Fingers
cards.subtitle: Late-night fuel along the I-35 frontage road
cards.notes: The Kultgen Expressway location serves chicken finger meals until 1 a.m. on most nights.
cards.short_summary: Raising Cane's is a popular fast-food choice for Baylor students, known for its limited menu and signature sauce.
cards.evidence_claim: The Raising Cane's at 801 S Kultgen Expressway is open until 1:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Waco, TX - 801 S Kultgen Expressway
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Midnight Pancakes at IHOP
cards.subtitle: 24-hour breakfast near campus
cards.notes: Located just off I-35, this IHOP provides a full breakfast menu at any hour for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: This 24-hour IHOP serves as a reliable late-night dining option for students seeking a sit-down meal.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP at 4109 South Jack Kultgen Expy is open 24 hours and offers late-night food.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Waco, TX on 4109 South Jack Kultgen Expy
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The Original Gut Pak
cards.subtitle: A legendary Waco barbecue tradition
cards.notes: Visit on Friday or Saturday evenings until 8 p.m. to try the famous Gut Pak in the biergarten.
cards.short_summary: Vitek's is home to the 'Gut Pak,' a famous combination of Fritos, brisket, and sausage that is a staple for the Baylor community.
cards.evidence_claim: Vitek's Market is open Friday-Saturday from 10:30 AM to 8:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Vitek's Market: Home
cards.access_notes: Open until 8 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.

cards.title: Late-Night Croissant Donuts
cards.subtitle: Artisanal treats in downtown Waco
cards.notes: Stop by the 4th Street location for fresh handmade donuts and espresso in an inviting ambiance.
cards.short_summary: Nightlight Donuts offers high-quality donuts and coffee, transitioning from a popular food truck to a permanent storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Nightlight Donuts & Coffee is located at 319 S. 4th Street and offers fresh hand-made donuts.
cards.source_title: Nightlight Donuts & Coffee - Visit Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Check daily for availability as popular flavors often sell out early.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student-preferred spaces at Baylor University, from quiet library gardens to active study commons and renovated historic lounges.

cards.title: The Garden Level Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Active Study Zone
cards.notes: Utilize the open-concept tables for group projects. The space features a makerspace and an enclosed outdoor garden with patio furniture and electrical outlets for laptop use.
cards.short_summary: A lively, collaborative study hub on the bottom floor of Moody Memorial Library featuring a makerspace and garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moody Garden Level is an active study zone with flexible furnishings for group work and includes a makerspace and access to the Gregory and Harvey Gardens.
cards.source_title: Study Zones in Moody and Jones | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; check the library website for seasonal and 24-hour finals schedules.

cards.title: Garden of Contentment
cards.subtitle: Quiet Outdoor Retreat
cards.notes: Find a teak bench near the central fountain for a quiet reading session. This landscaped garden offers a serene atmosphere away from the central campus bustle.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful, landscaped garden adjacent to the Armstrong Browning Library featuring teak benches and a fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garden of Contentment is a versatile outdoor gathering space and garden at Armstrong Browning Library with teak benches and a fountain.
cards.source_title: Baylor Dedicates Garden of Contentment at Armstrong Browning Library
cards.access_notes: Accessible during daylight hours; the library itself has specific public hours.

cards.title: The SUB Gameroom
cards.subtitle: Lower Level Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the Bill Daniel Student Center for bowling, billiards, and foosball. It is a primary spot for late-night student community building.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation center in the Bill Daniel Student Center featuring bowling lanes and table games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Gameroom is located on the lower level of the Bill Daniel Student Center and offers bowling, billiards, foosball, and shuffleboard.
cards.source_title: Baylor Gameroom | Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays 2pm-9pm during summer; extended hours during the academic year.

cards.title: Tidwell Graduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Renovated Historic Space
cards.notes: Access this dedicated lounge in the newly renovated Tidwell building. It provides a quiet, modern environment for graduate students to focus between classes.
cards.short_summary: A modern, dedicated lounge for graduate students located within the historic Tidwell Bible Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Tidwell Bible Building includes a dedicated graduate student lounge as part of its 57,000 square feet of enhanced academic space.
cards.source_title: Tidwell Bible Building - Give Light - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate students; building open during academic hours.

cards.title: BSB Atrium
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Science Hub
cards.notes: Use the open seating in the three-story atrium for collaborative study. It is a high-energy space with nearby dining options for quick breaks.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium in the Baylor Sciences Building used for individual and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The BSB atrium is a common area for students and faculty that offers a productive atmosphere for individual study and group work.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; common areas cannot be reserved for private meetings.

cards.title: Poage Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet Library Secret
cards.notes: Look for the angled floor-to-ceiling windows between Moody and Jones. This room is known for its serene atmosphere and is ideal for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, light-filled reading room located between the two main campus libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Poage Reading Room is described as a quiet, serene atmosphere for solo study, marked by its unique angled windows.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 7 scenic (and safe) study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; typically follows standard library quiet zone rules.

cards.title: Vara Martin Daniel Plaza
cards.subtitle: Central Seating Area
cards.notes: Sit at the outdoor tables between the SUB and Carroll Science Hall. It is a popular spot for outdoor lunch breaks and student organization tabling.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor plaza with seating located in the heart of campus near the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Vara Martin Daniel Plaza is an exterior lawn and seating space located between the Bill Daniel Student Center and Carroll Science Hall.
cards.source_title: Fountains, Namesakes and Rockets | Baylor Magazine
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as an outdoor campus space.

cards.title: Barfield Drawing Room
cards.subtitle: Traditional Lounge
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of the SUB for a classic study vibe. The room features traditional decor and comfortable couches for a living-room-style experience.
cards.short_summary: A traditionally decorated lounge on the second floor of the Bill Daniel Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barfield Drawing Room is a scenic study spot on the second floor of the SUB known for its traditional decor and quiet nooks.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during SUB operating hours; occasionally reserved for special events.

cards.title: Draper Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Historic Academic Nook
cards.notes: Find the courtyard tucked between Old Main and the Draper Academic Building. It is a shaded spot for students to pause between classes in the historic core.
cards.short_summary: A shaded outdoor courtyard located between the historic Old Main and Draper Academic Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The courtyard between Old Main and Draper is cited as one of the most beautiful study spots on campus.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as an outdoor campus space.

cards.entity_name: Jesse H. Jones Library First Floor
cards.title: Jones Library Study Area
cards.subtitle: Individual Study Zone
cards.notes: Venture to the first floor of Jones for a quieter, less crowded alternative to Moody. It houses the Crosshatch Art Gallery and specialized collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet individual study area in the Jesse H. Jones Library, often less busy than the main library foyer.
cards.evidence_claim: Jones 1st Floor is designated as an individual study zone and includes a study area, the Crosshatch Art Gallery, and government documents.
cards.source_title: Map and Location Guide - Moody & Jones Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; check for specific floor access times.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Baylor University, from visiting the live bear mascots to exploring world-class libraries and museums without spending a dime.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: Visit the Live Bear Mascots
cards.subtitle: Home of Judge Indy and Judge Belle
cards.notes: Visit the AZA-accredited habitat to see Baylor's live American black bears. It is free and open to the public daily for wildlife viewing and education.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-access habitat for Baylor's live bear mascots located in the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Bear Habitat is open to the public daily from 9:30 a.m. until 6 p.m. - free of charge.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Baylor Bear Habitat
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Bears may be inside during inclement weather or maintenance.

cards.title: Sip a Free Dr Pepper Float
cards.subtitle: A 70-Year Campus Tradition
cards.notes: Join the Baylor family for free Dr Pepper floats every Tuesday. This long-standing tradition offers a weekly social break in the Barfield Drawing Room.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social event where students and staff enjoy free Dr Pepper floats.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour is a tradition... every Tuesday from 3:00 - 4:00 pm... offers students the weekly chance at a sweet treat.
cards.source_title: Dr Pepper Hour | Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Tuesdays from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM in the Bill Daniel Student Center (SUB).

cards.title: Explore the Foyer of Meditation
cards.subtitle: World's Largest Browning Collection
cards.notes: Step into this Victorian-style library to see 62 stained-glass windows and rare manuscripts. The McLean Foyer of Meditation is a quiet spot for inspiration.
cards.short_summary: A stunning research library and museum with free public admission and historic architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit | Armstrong Browning Library & Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Tour the Natural History Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Free Daily Entry for Students
cards.notes: Explore discovery rooms and a historic village. Baylor students get free daily admission with their ID to see the mammoth exhibits and regional history.
cards.short_summary: A natural history museum and discovery center offering free admission to Baylor students.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Mayborn Museum is free for Baylor students every day of the week with a student ID.
cards.source_title: Visit | Mayborn Museum
cards.access_notes: Free for Baylor students with ID. Open Monday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM, Sunday 1 PM-5 PM.

cards.title: View Rotating Art Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Free Fine Arts Gallery
cards.notes: Visit the Hooper-Schaefer Fine Arts Center to see permanent collections and traveling exhibitions. Admission is always free for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum featuring diverse exhibitions with no admission fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Museum is FREE to everyone.
cards.source_title: Visit Us - Martin Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Saturday 10 AM-5 PM, Sunday 1 PM-5 PM. Closed Mondays.

cards.title: Relax at Fountain Mall
cards.subtitle: The Heart of Campus Social Life
cards.notes: Gather at this central landmark for outdoor studying or meeting friends. The interactive water features and surrounding green space are open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A central campus fountain and plaza used for student gatherings and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Students gather on Fountain Mall around the Rosenbalm Fountain at all hours to catch up with friends or take a break.
cards.source_title: A field guide to Baylor fountains
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Play Free Blacklight Bowling
cards.subtitle: Weekend Late Night Fun
cards.notes: Head to the SUB basement on Friday and Saturday nights for free blacklight bowling. It's a popular no-cost activity for students during Unight events.
cards.short_summary: Free bowling sessions for students during designated weekend late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Game Room... offer free blacklight bowling for students during Unight on Fridays and Saturdays from 8 p.m.
cards.source_title: Unight | Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Free bowling typically available Fridays and Saturdays starting at 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Listen to the McLane Carillon
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Bell Concerts
cards.notes: Find a spot on the lawn to hear the 48-bell carillon play from the tower of Pat Neff Hall. These musical performances are free for anyone on campus to enjoy.
cards.short_summary: Free public bell tower concerts performed on the historic McLane Carillon.
cards.evidence_claim: Stop and listen to an entire song playing on the McLane Carillon in Pat Neff Hall.
cards.source_title: Baylor Bucket List
cards.access_notes: Outdoor listening; check university calendar for scheduled performance times.

cards.title: Paddle the Brazos River
cards.subtitle: Free Watercraft for Students
cards.notes: Check out a kayak, canoe, or paddleboard for free with your student ID. It's the perfect way to explore the Brazos River right from the edge of campus.
cards.short_summary: Free rental of watercraft for Baylor students to use on the Brazos River.
cards.evidence_claim: Kayak, canoe or sail at the Baylor Marina... free for students with a valid Baylor ID.
cards.source_title: Marina - Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Free for students with ID. Seasonal hours apply; typically open afternoons in spring/fall.

cards.title: Stroll the Fellowship Garden
cards.subtitle: 9th & James Edible Landscape
cards.notes: Visit this sustainable campus space to see where students grow fresh produce. It's a peaceful spot for a walk and to learn about local food security efforts.
cards.short_summary: A student-led community garden focused on sustainability and education.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Community Gardens are transforming our campus into an edible learning landscape... the 'Fellowship Garden' is the founding garden.
cards.source_title: Baylor Community Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for walking and viewing during daylight hours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the silent stained-glass halls of Armstrong Browning to the high-tech pods in Moody, these are the most reliable environments for deep focus and collaboration on the Baylor campus.

cards.title: Sound-Dampening Moody PODS
cards.subtitle: Moody Memorial Library, Garden Level
cards.notes: Reserve these Framery pods for up to two hours. They offer power, HVAC, and lighting for focused solo work or small group collaboration in a sound-dampening environment.
cards.short_summary: Reservable sound-dampening pods for individual or small group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Moody PODS are reservable for up to two hours at a time and feature power, HVAC, and lighting for up to four people.
cards.source_title: Moody PODS | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; limited to 4 hours per week per user.

cards.title: Silent Study at Prichard Commons
cards.subtitle: Moody Memorial Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Enter this designated Silent Study Zone for absolute quiet. Group study and loud music are prohibited here to ensure a distraction-free environment for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: A strictly enforced silent study zone on the second floor of Moody Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Prichard Information Commons is a designated Silent Study Zone where group study is not an option and even loud music through headphones is considered a distraction.
cards.source_title: Study Zones in Moody and Jones | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; silence is strictly enforced.

cards.title: Serene Study in Armstrong Browning
cards.subtitle: 710 Speight Ave
cards.notes: Study amidst stained glass and Victorian poetry archives. This library is a mandatory quiet zone, offering a serene and picturesque atmosphere for reflective academic work.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, historic library known for its stained glass and peaceful atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Armstrong Browning Library is a mandatory quiet zone known for its stained glass windows and serene environment, ideal for reflective study.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

cards.title: Cozy Couches in Barfield
cards.subtitle: Bill Daniel Student Center, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Snag a comfortable couch or lounge chair in this historic room. It provides a social yet productive atmosphere, though it often fills up quickly due to its popularity.
cards.short_summary: A popular lounge-style study space with comfortable seating in the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barfield Drawing Room on the second floor of the Bill Daniel Student Center is a scenic study spot with cozy couches and lounge chairs.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 7 scenic (and safe) study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Available during Bill Daniel Student Center building hours.

cards.title: Modern Study at the BSB Atrium
cards.subtitle: Baylor Sciences Building
cards.notes: Utilize the open seating in this massive four-story atrium. It's a common area for science students, offering proximity to food and a bright, modern environment.
cards.short_summary: A bright, modern common area in the Baylor Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carlile Atrium in the Baylor Sciences Building is a common area for students and faculty, offering a modern study environment.
cards.source_title: Atrium and Outside Areas | Baylor Sciences Building
cards.access_notes: Swipe access for students enrolled in BSB classes extends until 10:00 p.m. on weekdays.

cards.title: Collaborative Foster Team Rooms
cards.subtitle: Paul L. Foster Campus for Business and Innovation
cards.notes: Reserve one of 35 team rooms designed for group projects. These spaces are equipped for collaboration and are primarily for business students and those in business classes.
cards.short_summary: High-tech group study rooms in the business school campus.
cards.evidence_claim: There are 35 Team Rooms within the Foster Campus which are reservable to HSB students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Team Rooms - Hankamer School of Business
cards.access_notes: Reservations required; priority given to Hankamer School of Business students.

cards.title: Focused Work at Jones Library
cards.subtitle: Jesse H. Jones Library
cards.notes: Find a quiet, less-crowded desk in the stacks of Jones Library. Connected to Moody by a hallway, it offers a calmer environment for long, undisturbed reading sessions.
cards.short_summary: A quieter, more intimate library space for focused individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Jones Library offers a calm, undisturbed space to read or research, with an intimate setting ideal for long study sessions.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » 5 famous study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; designated as an Individual Study Zone.

cards.title: Renovated Study in Tidwell
cards.subtitle: Tidwell Bible Building
cards.notes: Study in the newly renovated Tidwell building, which features technology-enabled classrooms and a dedicated lounge for graduate students amidst historic architecture.
cards.short_summary: Modernized study and seminar spaces in the historic Tidwell Bible Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Tidwell Bible Building includes technology-enabled classrooms, graduate seminar rooms, and a dedicated graduate student lounge.
cards.source_title: Tidwell Bible Building - Give Light - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Lounge access is dedicated to graduate students; classrooms available for general use.

cards.title: Legal Research Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Umphrey Law Center
cards.notes: Reserve a room for up to three hours in the Law Library. These rooms are equipped with dry-erase markers and are ideal for intensive group or individual legal research.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms in the Sheridan & John Eddie Williams Legal Research Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Law students may reserve study rooms in three-hour blocks per day; dry-erase markers are available at the Circulation Desk.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Law School | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Reservations limited to law students; rooms can be booked for the current or following day.

cards.title: Outdoor Study at Truett
cards.subtitle: George W. Truett Theological Seminary
cards.notes: Enjoy a peaceful outdoor study session in this scenic courtyard. It offers a quiet alternative to indoor libraries, perfect for reading during mild weather.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, scenic outdoor courtyard for peaceful study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Truett Seminary courtyard is recognized as one of the most beautiful and scenic study spots on the Baylor campus.
cards.source_title: BaylorProud » The 9 most beautiful study spots on Baylor's campus
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during daylight hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential streets and corridors immediately surrounding Baylor University, featuring student-favorite dining, retail, and local landmarks.

cards.title: Quick Bites Near Campus
cards.subtitle: S 5th St between I-35 and Bagby Ave
cards.notes: Grab a sub at Jersey Mike's or a quick sandwich at Subway along this high-traffic corridor directly adjacent to the university's western edge.
cards.short_summary: A primary commercial corridor on the western edge of campus featuring national fast-casual dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Jersey Mike's is located at 720 S 5th St #108 and Subway is at 1020 S 5th St, both serving the Baylor area.
cards.source_title: Jersey Mike's Subs – S 5th Street - Visit Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Public street with metered and business-specific parking; walkable from campus.

cards.title: Late Night Burger Runs
cards.subtitle: S 7th St near Speight Ave
cards.notes: Visit the local Whataburger for a classic Texas burger experience, a staple for students looking for late-night dining near the university.
cards.short_summary: A bustling thoroughfare known for its dining options, including the iconic 24-hour Whataburger.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger is located at 928 S 7th St, Waco, TX, providing 24-hour service near Baylor.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 928 S 7TH ST WACO, TX
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for dine-in and drive-thru.

cards.title: Study Sessions and Soup
cards.subtitle: S 8th St at I-35
cards.notes: Meet for group projects or a quiet study session at Panera Bread, conveniently located just across the highway from the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A commercial block featuring Panera Bread, serving as a popular off-campus study and meeting spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Panera Bread is located at 1000 S 8th St in Waco, TX, offering dine-in and pickup services.
cards.source_title: Panera Bread at 1000 S 8th St Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the I-35 frontage road; ample parking available.

cards.title: Student Living Corridor
cards.subtitle: Speight Ave between S 11th and S 15th
cards.notes: Walk this street to find local favorites like Jimmy John's and various student-oriented apartment complexes within walking distance of class.
cards.short_summary: A key residential and commercial street for Baylor students, housing several popular eateries and housing options.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's is located at 1508 Speight Ave, serving the Baylor student population.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Waco | Jimmy John's 2440
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian-friendly street with limited street parking.

cards.title: The Student Housing Hub
cards.subtitle: Bagby Ave near S 5th St
cards.notes: Navigate the heart of off-campus living where major apartment complexes like The Centre and 19Eleven house a large portion of the student body.
cards.short_summary: A primary residential street for upperclassmen, lined with modern student apartment communities.
cards.evidence_claim: The 19Eleven/The Centre apartments are located at 600 Bagby Ave, catering specifically to Baylor students.
cards.source_title: 19Eleven/The Centre - Bear Cribs
cards.access_notes: Residential street; parking is typically reserved for residents of the various complexes.

cards.title: Iconic West Coast Burgers
cards.subtitle: S 4th St at I-35
cards.notes: Experience the popular In-N-Out Burger, a frequent stop for students located at the gateway between campus and downtown Waco.
cards.short_summary: A commercial block featuring In-N-Out Burger and Chipotle, serving as a major dining destination for the Baylor community.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out Burger is located at 801 South 4th St. and Chipotle is at 721 S 4th St.
cards.source_title: Waco, TX, 801 South 4th St.. - In-N-Out Burger
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 1:00 AM (1:30 AM on Fri/Sat).

cards.title: Antique Shopping and Soul Food
cards.subtitle: La Salle Ave near S 12th St
cards.notes: Explore the LaSalle Shoppes for unique finds or grab a home-cooked meal at Jess Soul Food along this historic Waco thoroughfare.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial avenue south of campus known for its antique malls and local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: LaSalle Shoppes is located at 2223 La Salle Ave and Jess Soul Food is at 810 La Salle Ave.
cards.source_title: LaSalle Shoppes - Visit Waco, TX
cards.access_notes: Public street with storefront parking; LaSalle Shoppes is open Mon-Sat 10 AM - 5 PM.

cards.title: Riverfront Recreation
cards.subtitle: University Parks Dr along the Brazos River
cards.notes: Walk or bike along the Brazos River on this scenic drive that connects the campus to downtown and the Cameron Park trail system.
cards.short_summary: A scenic road bordering the campus and the Brazos River, offering access to parks and riverfront views.
cards.evidence_claim: University Parks Drive runs along the Brazos River, providing access to the Waco Riverwalk and campus facilities.
cards.source_title: Baylor University Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Public road with adjacent paved walking trails; free to access.

cards.title: Modern Student Living
cards.subtitle: S 11th St at Speight Ave
cards.notes: Find modern apartment living at 11th Street Flats, a popular choice for students seeking proximity to both campus and the La Salle corridor.
cards.short_summary: A residential street featuring newer apartment developments popular with the Baylor student community.
cards.evidence_claim: 11th Street Flats is located at 1722 S 11th St, offering 2, 3, and 4-bedroom options for students.
cards.source_title: 11th Street Flats - Bear Cribs
cards.access_notes: Residential area; primarily accessible by foot or bike for local students.

cards.title: Campus Perimeter Access
cards.subtitle: Dutton Ave between S 4th and S 8th
cards.notes: Utilize the Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility for campus visits or to access the university's western administrative offices.
cards.short_summary: A street on the western edge of campus primarily serving university administrative and parking needs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility is a key university structure located along this street.
cards.source_title: Dutton Avenue Office and Parking Facility - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Parking facility requires a university permit or paid visitor parking.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Explore the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the Baylor experience, from running the field to enjoying Waco-born soda floats.

cards.title: The Baylor Line
cards.subtitle: Freshman Spirit Run
cards.notes: Join thousands of freshmen in gold jerseys as they run onto the field at McLane Stadium to create a human tunnel for the football team.
cards.short_summary: A 50-year-old tradition where freshmen run onto the football field before home games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Line was established in 1970 and consists of new students wearing jerseys with their graduation year who run onto the field at McLane Stadium.
cards.source_title: Traditions - About Baylor
cards.access_notes: Occurs before every home football game at McLane Stadium; participation is exclusive to freshmen.

cards.title: Dr Pepper Hour
cards.subtitle: Weekly Float Social
cards.notes: Head to the Barfield Drawing Room every Tuesday afternoon for free Dr Pepper floats and a break from the academic grind.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social event featuring free Dr Pepper floats, a tradition since 1953.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour occurs every Tuesday from 3-4 p.m. in the Barfield Drawing Room, serving free Dr Pepper floats to the Baylor community.
cards.source_title: Happy 70th birthday, Dr Pepper Hour! - Baylor Proud
cards.access_notes: Held in the Bill Daniel Student Center (SUB) Barfield Drawing Room on Tuesdays during the semester.

cards.title: Diadeloso
cards.subtitle: The Day of the Bear
cards.notes: Take a break from classes for a full day of outdoor games, live music, and the signature tug-of-war competition on Fountain Mall.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring holiday where classes are canceled for a day of campus-wide festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Diadeloso, meaning 'Day of the Bear,' began in 1932 as All-University Day to provide students a break from classes for fellowship and games.
cards.source_title: History of Diadeloso - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Held annually on a Tuesday in the spring; classes are officially canceled for the day.

cards.title: Christmas on Fifth Street
cards.subtitle: Holiday Campus Celebration
cards.notes: Experience a live nativity with camels, horse-drawn carriages, and the KOT Christmas Tree lighting along the campus's main corridor.
cards.short_summary: A massive holiday festival featuring a tree lighting, live nativity, and seasonal activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas on Fifth Street includes a live nativity, carriage rides, and the Kappa Omega Tau tree lighting, which began in 1967.
cards.source_title: What is Baylor's Christmas on 5th Street?
cards.access_notes: Annual event held in early December along 5th Street and Burleson Quad.

cards.title: The Immortal Ten
cards.subtitle: Memorial Tradition
cards.notes: Listen to the story of the 1927 basketball team during the Freshman Mass Meeting and visit the bronze monument in Traditions Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A solemn remembrance of ten students killed in a 1927 bus-train collision.
cards.evidence_claim: The Immortal Ten are honored annually during Homecoming Mass Meeting to remember the 10 students killed in a 1927 accident.
cards.source_title: The Immortal Ten - Waco History
cards.access_notes: The monument is located in Traditions Plaza and is accessible to the public year-round.

cards.title: Homecoming Bonfire
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Blaze
cards.notes: Gather on Fountain Mall for the pep rally and the lighting of a massive bonfire built by the freshman class.
cards.short_summary: A central event of the nation's oldest homecoming, featuring a massive student-built fire.
cards.evidence_claim: The Homecoming bonfire has been a tradition since 1909 and is currently lit on Friday night of Homecoming week on Fountain Mall.
cards.source_title: Extravaganza, Pep Rally and Bonfire | Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Takes place late Friday night during Homecoming week; open to the public.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: The Bear Habitat
cards.subtitle: Home of the Mascots
cards.notes: Visit the on-campus home of Baylor's live bear mascots, Judge Indy and Judge Belle, who are cared for by the Chamber of Commerce.
cards.short_summary: A Class C zoo on campus housing the university's live North American Black Bear mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: Baylor has had live bear mascots since 1917, and they are currently housed in the Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat on campus.
cards.source_title: The Baylor Bear Habitat - Waco History
cards.access_notes: Located near the SUB; the habitat is viewable by the public daily.

cards.title: All-University Sing
cards.subtitle: Musical Showcase
cards.notes: Watch student organizations compete in elaborate 7-minute Broadway-style musical acts at Waco Hall every February.
cards.short_summary: A massive song-and-dance competition involving hundreds of students and professional production.
cards.evidence_claim: All-University Sing began in 1953 and features student groups performing choreographed musical acts in Waco Hall.
cards.source_title: History of Sing | Student Activities
cards.access_notes: Performances held over two weekends in February; tickets are required and often sell out quickly.

cards.title: Steppin' Out
cards.subtitle: Day of Service
cards.notes: Join thousands of fellow students for a Saturday dedicated to community service projects across the city of Waco.
cards.short_summary: One of the largest student-led community service events in the country, held twice a year.
cards.evidence_claim: Steppin' Out is a 40-year-old tradition where thousands of students serve the Waco community twice a year.
cards.source_title: Steppin' Out Day of Service - Baylor Missions
cards.access_notes: Occurs one Saturday in the fall and one in the spring; registration is required for students.

cards.title: Ring Out
cards.subtitle: Passing of the Spirit
cards.notes: Observe the symbolic passing of the 'Baylor Spirit' from seniors to juniors in the Burleson Quadrangle before graduation.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-season ceremony where seniors pass leadership responsibilities to the junior class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senior Ring Out ceremony began in 1927 and involves seniors passing a chain of ivy to juniors in the Quadrangle.
cards.source_title: About | Commencement | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring semester in the Burleson Quadrangle.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Baylor University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Unpack with the Help of Move2BU
cards.subtitle: A high-energy welcome to your new residence hall
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall during your morning time slot. Student volunteers will help unload your vehicle and carry belongings to your room in minutes.
cards.short_summary: Move2BU is the university's coordinated move-in event where volunteers assist new students with their belongings.
cards.evidence_claim: Move2BU for first-year communities takes place on August 20, 2026, from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm.
cards.source_title: Events | Student Life - Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Requires assigned move-in time slot and residence hall placement.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: Visit the Live Bear Mascots
cards.subtitle: Meet Judge Indy and Judge Belle at the heart of campus
cards.notes: Walk through the habitat walkway to see the American black bears. The facility features a waterfall and pools for the university's official live mascots.
cards.short_summary: The Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat is a licensed zoo facility on campus housing Baylor's live bear mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Bear Habitat is open to the public daily from 9:30 a.m. until 6 p.m. free of charge.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Baylor Bear Habitat
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9:30 AM - 6:00 PM; bears may be indoors during inclement weather.

cards.title: Attend the Candlelight Worship Service
cards.subtitle: A reflective Sunday evening tradition on the mall
cards.notes: Join fellow new students on Fountain Mall for a Sunday night worship service that marks the spiritual beginning of the academic year.
cards.short_summary: The Candlelight Worship Service is a signature Welcome Week event held outdoors on Fountain Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Candlelight Worship Service is scheduled for Sunday, August 23, 2026, from 8:00 pm to 9:00 pm on Fountain Mall.
cards.source_title: First 50 Days - New Student Programs | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students as part of Welcome Week programming.

cards.title: Run the Field at McLane Stadium
cards.subtitle: A high-speed tradition for all new students
cards.notes: Don your gold Line jersey and run onto the field before kickoff. You'll form a human tunnel for the team before heading to the dedicated student section.
cards.short_summary: The Baylor Line is a tradition where new students run across the football field before home games at McLane Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Line, established in 1970, consists of new students who run onto the field at McLane Stadium before each home football game.
cards.source_title: Traditions - About Baylor
cards.access_notes: Requires a Baylor Line jersey and a student ticket for the game.

cards.title: Explore the Armstrong Browning Library
cards.subtitle: A quiet retreat with world-class stained glass
cards.notes: Visit this research library to see the world's largest collection of Robert and Elizabeth Barrett Browning's works and 62 stained glass windows.
cards.short_summary: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is a dedicated research center and museum on the Baylor campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Armstrong Browning Library & Museum is free and open to the public, with hours typically from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Libraries, Museums, and the Press
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Mix a Float at Dr Pepper Hour
cards.subtitle: A sweet Tuesday afternoon tradition since 1953
cards.notes: Head to the Barfield Drawing Room for a Dr Pepper float. It is a weekly social hour where students, faculty, and staff gather for free treats.
cards.short_summary: Dr Pepper Hour is a long-standing Baylor tradition where the community gathers for Dr Pepper floats every Tuesday.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour occurs every Tuesday from 3:00 pm to 4:00 pm in the Barfield Drawing Room of the Bill Daniel Student Center.
cards.source_title: Dr Pepper Hour - Student Activities | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Held weekly on Tuesdays; check the student activities calendar for kickoff events.

cards.title: Listen to the McLane Carillon
cards.subtitle: The soundtrack of the Baylor campus
cards.notes: Find a spot on Founders Mall to hear the 48-bell carillon. The bells play hymns and university songs throughout the day from the iconic gold tower.
cards.short_summary: The McLane Carillon in Pat Neff Hall is a 22-ton instrument that provides musical performances for the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McLane Carillon in the tower of Pat Neff Hall features 48 cast bronze bells and is played by the University Carillonneur.
cards.source_title: The McLane Carillon | About Baylor
cards.access_notes: Best heard from the grounds around Pat Neff Hall or Founders Mall.

cards.title: Grab a Coffee at Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: The classic student hangout just off campus
cards.notes: Order a 'Cowboy Coffee' and find a seat on the back patio. This converted house is a staple for studying and late-night student socializing.
cards.short_summary: Common Grounds is a popular local coffee shop located adjacent to the Baylor University campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds is a long-standing coffee shop near campus frequently featured in student media like The Baylor Lariat.
cards.source_title: Common Grounds - The Baylor Lariat
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check local listings for specific late-night hours.

cards.title: Join a Club at Late Night
cards.subtitle: Explore 400+ student organizations in one night
cards.notes: Browse booths from hundreds of student groups across campus. It's the primary way to find your niche, from intramural sports to academic societies.
cards.short_summary: Late Night is an annual fall event where student organizations recruit new members through a campus-wide fair.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Night 2026 is scheduled for Friday, August 28, from 8:00 pm to 10:30 pm, featuring 400+ student organizations.
cards.source_title: Calendar | Student Activities | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Held at various locations including the Student Union and McLane Student Life Center.

cards.title: Attend a Performance at Waco Hall
cards.subtitle: The historic home of Baylor's major productions
cards.notes: Visit this 2,200-seat theater for university events. It hosts everything from orientation sessions to the famous All-University Sing performances.
cards.short_summary: Waco Hall is a historic multipurpose theater on the Baylor campus used for major university events and student productions.
cards.evidence_claim: Waco Hall is a 2,200-seat theater that hosts a variety of university events and is managed by Student Activities.
cards.source_title: Waco Hall | Student Activities | Baylor University
cards.access_notes: Access depends on specific event schedules and ticket availability.
